==Ingredients==
* 1 small baking [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]] (optional)

==Procedure==

# Core apple almost to, but not through, the bottom.
# Mix together raisins, brown sugar and cinnamon. Stuff apple cavity with this mixure.
# Cover apple with [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]]. Pierce plastic to allow for steam. 
# [[Cookbook:Microwave|Microwave]] on HIGH (100% power) for 2–3 minutes. Test doneness with [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]]. Apple will continue to cook slightly after microwaving. 
# Let apple stand several minutes or until cool.
# Serve with sour cream if desired.
